toolchain: TheRock 10.0, Clang 23; CMake windows-release preset, RelWithDebInfo, /O2 /Ob1 /DNDEBUG, BUILD_TESTING=OFF
build_overlay: Both arms include the same pre-existing Flash-Next clang-cl forwarding of -ffast-math and -fno-finite-math-only. The overlay is not a product-source change in this PR.

assertions: cached input at least initial depth minus128

functional_scope: Qwen27/off long-context stops at long_responses_sampled after fully checked 98K cold/cached cases; the final sampled Responses record is also checked offline for completed status, exact keyword JSON and cached prefix using the original assertions; later long-context cases were not run in that mode on v12. Qwen27/DFlash2 also runs the complete unmodified long-context SDK suite after the measured cold/replay/replay sequence, so its first SDK case starts warm. Its actual cold evidence is the preceding samples. Flash-Next/MTP full suites and timing are retained from v9; v10/v11 subsequent routing and turnover changes select identical host behavior when device backing is unavailable, as for Flash. Final v12 additionally runs Flash/off suites and warmed MTP speed comparisons.
timing_method: Unchanged upstream 5%/10ms per-request/per-phase qualification, retaining all eligible unchanged-main controls. Inconclusive is advisory, not a pass or a claim of no possible slowdown.

resident_sdk.initial_history: resident after the three measured requests

earlier_insufficient_headroom_v11.outcome: Cold capture refused at host capacity; first replay still waited for disk, so this version was rejected. The appended SDK run was deliberately stopped; raw records retained.

long_history.composition: Primary measured/SDK/overwrite run and separate corrected durability run use the same frozen v12 binary and preset. The first combined restart failure is retained; only the corrected run establishes restart and baseline-reader compatibility. Restart timings are compatibility observations, not a qualified matched speed comparison.

checks.windows: Shared cache tests5/5 passed onv11 in24.50s; unchanged shared CPU sources in v12. Revised v12 HIP provider test passed0.47s (0.58s wall), including shortHost,1MiB device exhaustion, host fallback and full readback

recorder.note: Bounded retries apply only to a transient Windows lock replacing the recorder JSON, never to inference. Both arms use the wrapper. Journals retain any added inter-request I/O delay.

baseline.scope: Only metrics.Recorder clock; inference requests and SDK assertions unchanged.

earlier_v11_diagnostic.scope: Only metrics.Recorder clock; inference requests and SDK assertions unchanged.

final_gate_official_control.selection: Same initial 13 requests through both fully asserted invalid_reasoning responses; later requests omitted from this derived prefix only, raw full records retained.

clock_refinement.reason: Python 3.12 monotonic uses GetTickCount64 at15.625ms resolution on this host. A matched QPC repeat of the same conversation prefix through the expected HTTP400 invalid_reasoning checks resolves coarse client timing ambiguity. Original coarse observations remain in qualification; thresholds remain5%/10ms.

recorder.wrapper_note: The current wrapper hash includes an optional QPC-only diagnostic hook. Earlier runs used identical default recorder behavior before that optional hook was added.

retained_incomplete_attempts: final-v5-flash-serial: Windows recorder PermissionError5; repeated with a new output directory.
long-candidate-v5d: harness read cache_disk_hit from the wrong response object after successful measured and overwrite replays; corrected before final durable validation.
flash-owner-v6-a: requested host budget was clipped at startup; no inference qualification.
flash-pressure-v7-02 and flash-v8-new-1: Windows recorder PermissionError5; raw records retained, then bounded recorder-only retry added.

long-candidate-v12d: measurements, full resident-start long SDK and overwrite replay passed; the combined restart probe stopped too early because its harness accepted an older published event after a later capture. The restart missed. Corrected the wait to match capture IDs and require a current disk manifest, then reran durability separately as long-durable-v12d without repeating the already-passed mixed-history SDK.
limits: Device backing is enabled for Qwen27 only; Flash-Next is compatibility coverage.

An earlier Flash-Next long-thinking cancellation waited 15759.2ms for publication and recorded one incomplete persistence job; controlled repeats did not reproduce it. No Flash-Next publication-latency fix is claimed.
Native device allocation is capped at8GiB and guarded during growth; existing segments stay committed until the cache and last reader close.
Linux GPU and other GPU/OS configurations are not runtime-qualified.
Disk fsync/publication latency is unchanged; related issue1180 remains open.
The host-only fallback plan preserves baseline admission, but mixed-pool admission remains conservative when neither individual plan fits.

Automatic host budgets are the same preset but grants vary with host availability; exact grants are retained. The nearby v11 control had a slightly larger host grant than v12 and still waited for disk on first replay.

short_history_policy.choice: Host row allowance=min(half backing capacity, capacity minus two complete per-component allocation classes)/total row width; only later complete chunks prefer device backing.
short_history_policy.retention: Reuse protection counts committed device bytes, not unused device capacity.
short_history_policy.regression_test: The unused-device-capacity turnover test failed before the fix and passes on Windows and Linux afterward.

diagnostics.scope: Temporary instrumented builds, never substituted for uninstrumented timing qualification.
diagnostics.observed: Reported snapshot durations include time outside Capture. Actual capture work also increased in a tested v9 case; therefore the discrepancy was not dismissed as instrumentation noise. Short-history routing and unused-capacity turnover were fixed before final qualification.
diagnostics.source_policy: All temporary profiling edits were restored byte-for-byte before v10/v11 changes.
